name: sde-social-data
description: Social Data Engine as a host plugin: list providers, probe a URL, collect bounded canonical Observations, and read run/provenance status. Read-only surface, no credentials, no browser required for the deterministic provider.

stdio_mcp.notes: One JSON-RPC 2.0 request per line on stdin, one response per line on stdout. EOF exits 0.

http_mcp.notes: POST-only, loopback bind, requires Content-Type: application/json and a loopback Host header; optional --token.

tools_source_note: The tool list is NOT duplicated here: query tools/list from either transport (single source of truth: src/mcp_server.py TOOL_SCHEMAS).
access_mode: public/authenticated (declared per provider adapter; browser collection reuses the operator's own logged-in session — see policies/ACCEPTABLE-USE.md)
